transcript: Never ever tell your mother don't meddle in my life. Because those words don't just hurt, they leave scars that never fully heal. A mother doesn't meddle in your life to control. She meddles because she loves, because she sees dangers you can't see yet, because her heart is always a few steps ahead of yours. Every time you reject her, you tear a piece from her soul, even though she smiles so you won't notice. Don't hurt the one who gave you life. Don't push away the one who first held you. Don't ignore the one who would be willing to have nothing as long as she sees you well. Don't wait to lose her, to value her. Honoring your mother is a blessing you'll one day be grateful for. Think about how many times she told you something you didn't want to hear, and in time it turned out she was right. Think about how many times you pushed her away out of pride when all she was doing was protecting you. Think about how many nights she didn't sleep, worried about you while you didn't even know. A mother doesn't ask you to obey her. She asks you to listen to her. She doesn't ask you to do what she says. She asks you not to erase her from your path. And when she's no longer here, those words you said to her will weigh more than any mistake you've made in your life. Write in the comments, I love you mom. If this touched you and send it to your mother right now, but I want you to understand something. If you react with anger when someone worries about you, it's not because you're a bad person, it's because you're exhausted inside. When you live stressed at your limit, carrying more than you can handle, any word makes you explode. Even those that come from love, it's not that you don't love your mother, it's that your body has no space to receive anything else. Stress closes you off, irritates you, distances you from those who love you most. And if you want to stop reacting like this, learn to receive love without it hurting and live with a calm that doesn't hurt those around you. I've been learning in silence for over 20 years how to do it, and everything I know is inside the path back to calm. The link is in my profile.
